participation.context: Confirmed the four lines, paid twopence, and refused the pack.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Read the line back, named the price of a letter, and took the twopence.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

relations.quote: Twopence the letter, sixpence the parcel, and nothing for a speech in the doorway.
The six are not written again.

story.body: You heard Hobbins read Saturday back from his list. You paid twopence for the letter. You did not make a parcel, did not send the 60s, and did not rewrite the older papers.

title: Paid twopence and heard Saturday read back
